artboards.title: Default — nothing to do but act
Blocked — what you actually hit today

annotations.text:
The old hub showed the same money sliced two ways at once — 'broker cash' (by asset type) beside 'unassigned' (by ownership), joined by a dot as if they were peers. And three verbs with three models: % steppers + Apply, Assign, Debit.

This is one decomposition and one verb.

'Not assigned' is a bucket in the same list as the strategies, in the same shape. That is the whole simplification: assigning, debiting and re-splitting are all just moving money from one bucket to another.
